paires.profil_a: Conflict avoidant/hoarder (unsaid, “everything is fine,” delayed outburst)
paires.miroir_b: Conflict seeker/provocateur (direct, brash, daily argument)
paires.blessure_commune: Humiliated Child (“if I say what is wrong, I am rejected or destroyed”)
paires.activations: M: Hermit, Intellectualizer — P: Angry (single explosion), Runaway — E: Humiliated
paires.reveil: Drip-feeding anger: saying “you hurt me” the same day, cold
paires.piege: The final explosion that destroys everything — and the confirmation that “conflict is deadly”
micro_pas: Name the wound the same day, cold: "that hurt me when…", without judging the other.
Before exploding, write 3 lines about what happened — then say them (or hand them over).

boucles.cycle: A hoards in silence for days → he sends a too-intense message, suddenly → B, in shame, rereads their whole past as lies and predation → A, scared by the shame, flees the conflict, justifies himself, blames her (Abandoned Child, then Guilty Child) → B closes up in turn → loop.
boucles.sortie: A names his need coldly, in one sentence, before it escalates; B says hers without accusing.

boucles.cycle: B throws out a direct remark that A experiences as humiliation → A's Angry part explodes all at once, delayed → B, surprised, strikes back → A's Humiliated Child takes over, he collapses or goes quiet → B feels guilty → loop.
boucles.sortie: A hears the remark as a piece of data, not a verdict; B phrases the criticism without targeting the person.

triangle.danse: A accumulates in silence (Victim) while B provokes (Persecutor) — then A explodes and becomes a Persecutor in turn, and B shuts down: the roles rotate.

paires.profil_a: Anxious-avoidant (flees intimacy, goes into exile to process, returns through gift)
paires.miroir_b: Anxious-concerned/protesting (chases, tests, threatens to leave, screams for reassurance)
paires.blessure_commune: Abandoned Child (“people always end up leaving me”)
paires.activations: M: Hermit, Controller — P: Runaway, Declarer — E: Abandoned
paires.reveil: Survive attachment: stay present for 48 hours instead of “it’s over”; tolerate the need
paires.piege: The infinite chase-flight dance, each break confirming the two prophecies
micro_pas: Replace "it's over" with "I need 24 hours" — and come back.
Stay present for 48 hours after a conflict, without fleeing or threatening to leave.

boucles.cycle: B feels ignored → he threatens to leave, tests (anxious-preoccupied) → A, panicked, goes into exile to process, "I need 24 hours" → B shouts that he's leaving → A's Abandoned Child takes the wheel, he returns with a gift instead of saying the need → B sees the gift as calculation → loop.
boucles.sortie: A replaces "it's over" with "I need 24 hours, I'll be back"; B says "I'm afraid of losing you" instead of threatening to leave.

boucles.cycle: B clings, calls, demands proof → A feels invaded by the Critic (Controller), he freezes and goes blank → B reads the coldness as abandonment → B's anger rises, he shouts → A's Abandoned Child, he flees → B feels guilty and chases → loop.
boucles.sortie: A says "I'm not leaving, I need a pause"; B supports one reassuring sentence instead of shouting it.

triangle.danse: B pursues and tests (Persecutor), A flees and freezes (Victim) — pursuit intensifies flight, flight intensifies pursuit.

paires.profil_a: Savior / People-pleaser (gives to exist, does not know how to receive)
paires.miroir_b: Chronic victim / in permanent distress (receives without ever fulfilling, “yes but”) — Woman
paires.blessure_commune: Invisible / Parentified Child (“I only exist because of what I bring”)
paires.activations: M: Savior (gives MORE) — P: Exhaustion, Dorsal — E: Invisible
paires.reveil: Exist without bringing; receive without calculating; save the inner child, not the adults
paires.piege: The endless gift that never fills — “I gave everything and I am still nothing”
micro_pas: Receive help without giving back right away: simply say "thank you".
Offer presence without fixing anything: "I'm here, you don't have to do anything for me".

boucles.cycle: A gives, anticipates, rescues (Rescuer) → B receives without ever being filled, in permanent distress → A is drained, his Critic says "not enough" → A's Angry part explodes, then the shame → A gives again to atone → A's Invisible Child: he only exists by giving → loop.
boucles.sortie: A practices saying "no" and receiving without giving back; B names a need without turning it into a demand.

boucles.cycle: A pays for everything to exist through giving → B enjoys it then reproaches him ("you never take care of yourself") → A's Rescuer feels useless, devalued → he gives even more → B is satiated and pulls away → A's Abandoned Child → loop.
boucles.sortie: A sets a limit ("I give up to here"); B asks for what he needs instead of watching for generosity.

triangle.danse: A rescues unasked (Rescuer), B receives without growing (Victim) — the more A saves, the more powerless B becomes, the more exhausted A gets.

paires.profil_a: Grandiose narcissist (superiority, image, “I don’t need anyone,” never apologizes)
paires.miroir_b: Empath / care giver (forgets himself, absorbs, forgives, understands everything)
paires.blessure_commune: Invisible Child (both have not been seen — one decided to make himself unforgettable, the other to make himself indispensable)
paires.activations: M: Arrogant, Guardian of the image — P: Angry (when the image breaks), Devaluation of the other — E: Invisible, Humiliated
paires.reveil: For the narcissist: feel, ask, be vulnerable without breaking down. For the empath: love yourself, set limits, exist without serving
paires.piege: Mutual consumption: the empath feeds the narcissist, the narcissist confirms the empath in “I only count by what I give”. If the activation is unidirectional → trap, not mirror (see 4.3)
micro_pas: Ask the other for concrete help, without turning it into a performance.
Say a real emotion without decorating it: "I was scared", "I need".

boucles.cycle: A needs to be admired (Arrogant, Image Guard) → B, empathetic, validates him without limits → A feels entitled, scorns, never apologizes → B fades, swallows the humiliation → one day B's Angry part explodes, she leaves → A's Humiliated Child, he is devastated by the gaze he wanted to control → loop.
boucles.sortie: B says an early "no", without exploding; A hears a criticism without living it as a downfall.

boucles.cycle: A never apologizes, keeps the perfect mask → B absorbs, understands everything, forgives → A mistakes this letting go for his superiority → B blunts, goes dorsal → the lack of empathy strikes A's Invisible Child (no one really sees him) → A gets angry or shuts down → loop.
boucles.sortie: A says a concrete "sorry" once; B doesn't forgive automatically, he names what wore him down.

triangle.danse: A dominates and despises (Persecutor), B absorbs and forgives (Rescuer) — A's contempt needs B's absorption to hold, and the reverse.

paires.profil_a: Vulnerable narcissist (hidden fragility, victim of everyone, suppressed rage)
paires.miroir_b: Empath / emotional mirror (validates, reassures, cuts himself off from his own needs)
paires.blessure_commune: Humiliated + Abandoned Child (one protects himself by complaining, the other by giving)
paires.activations: M: Victim, Accuser — P: Anger, Blocker — E: Humiliated
paires.reveil: Dignity without complaint (A); the limit without the guilt (B)
paires.piege: The endless victim-savior-persecutor triangle
micro_pas: Validate the other without forgetting yourself: "I hear you, and I need…".
Hold a simple boundary, without drowning it in excuses.

boucles.cycle: A sees himself as a victim, bottled rage (vulnerable narcissist) → B validates, reassures, cuts herself off from her needs → A reads one of B's silences as persecution → A's Accuser turns everything against B → B feels guilty and apologizes → A's Guilty Child: he relishes being right then self-destructs → loop.
boucles.sortie: A names his own part in the conflict; B stops apologizing for what she didn't do.

boucles.cycle: A watches others' recognition, feels scorned → B secures him, reflects a flattering image → A doubts it's genuine, he tests, accuses → B goes quiet, hurt → A screams internally, plays the victim → A's Humiliated Child wants to be seen without having to ask → loop.
boucles.sortie: A stops measuring his worth by B's eyes; B says "you matter to me" without submitting.

triangle.danse: A suffers the world and complains (Victim), B validates and reassures endlessly (Rescuer) — A's complaint is fed by B's care.

paires.profil_a: Controller / rigidity (plan everything, lock everything, anxiety of the unexpected)
paires.miroir_b: Chaotic/unpredictable (messy, spontaneous, forgets, changes your mind)
paires.blessure_commune: Terrified Child (“the world is not safe” – one masters it, the other gives in to it)
paires.activations: M: Controller (locks harder) — P: Angry, TCA, Anesthetist — E: Terrified
paires.reveil: Tolerate uncertainty (A); create container (B)
paires.piege: The war for control: one suffocates, the other flees — each confirming the dangerousness of the world
micro_pas: Let something unexpected happen without locking it down: plan nothing for an outing.
Breathe 3 times before "fixing" the other's organization.

boucles.cycle: A plans everything (Controller), anxious at the unexpected → B forgets, improvises, changes his mind → A corrects, redoes, gets angry → his Angry/Critic part rises → B feels controlled, sows chaos deliberately → A's Terrified Child: without a frame, he panics → loop.
boucles.sortie: A lets go one non-vital variable; B warns before changing his mind.

boucles.cycle: A locks the schedule, demands → B arrives late, forgets the key → A's Controller tenses, he watches → B feels judged and flees → A's Terrified Child: the unexpected = danger → he demands more, B deserts → loop.
boucles.sortie: A announces a tolerable lateness limit; B commits to a single warning.

triangle.danse: A locks everything down (Persecutor), B overflows and forgets (Victim) — B's chaos justifies A's control, A's control feeds B's chaos.

paires.profil_a: Perfectionist/fearful procrastinator (nothing is ever good enough, doesn't start or finish)
paires.miroir_b: Carefree / “that’s enough” (delivers at 80%, doesn’t care about the look, plays)
paires.blessure_commune: Humiliated Child (“one mistake = proof that I’m worthless”)
paires.activations: M: Perfectionist, Critical — P: Paralysis, Abandonment — E: Humiliated
paires.reveil: The imperfect as proof of courage (A); care and standard (B)
paires.piege: Mutual paralysis: one does not dare, the other does not succeed
micro_pas: Deliberately deliver work at 80% — and watch what happens.
Say "that's enough" out loud, then really stop.

boucles.cycle: A doesn't start or doesn't finish (perfectionist procrastinator) → B delivers at 80%, fearless → A admires then rages, "it's not done" → his Critic crushes him, he blocks → B, carefree, doesn't understand, insists → A feels judged, ashamed, Humiliated Child → loop.
boucles.sortie: A allows a "good enough" version by a fixed date; B delivers even imperfectly and says it.

boucles.cycle: A wants an impeccable home (Perfectionist) → B plays, leaves mess, doesn't see the disorder → A's Critic complains, he redoes everything → B feels infantilized, does it on purpose → A's Humiliated Child: order is his worth → loop.
boucles.sortie: A accepts two imperfect zones; B tidies one thing in exchange for play space.

triangle.danse: A judges what is not perfect (Persecutor), B takes it and drifts away (Victim) — the more A criticizes, the more B lets go.

paires.profil_a: Hermit/loner (few friends, “I prefer to be alone”, distrust)
paires.miroir_b: Social / open (makes friends in one evening, confides quickly, invades)
paires.blessure_commune: Humiliated or Terrified Child (“others end up judging / the world is dangerous”)
paires.activations: M: Hermit, Hypervigilant — P: Fugitive, Dorsal — E: Terrified
paires.reveil: Graduated confidence (A); discernment (B)
paires.piege: The social exhaustion of one, the feeling of abandonment of the other
micro_pas: Say yes to ONE invitation, with an announced limit: "I can come for 1 hour".
Answer a message the same day, without rewriting it three times.

boucles.cycle: A prefers to be alone (Hermit), distrust → B bonds in one evening, confides fast, invades → A feels sucked in, his Hermit raises a wall → B, frustrated, tells others → A reads it as betrayal → A's Terrified Child: crowds and trust = danger → loop.
boucles.sortie: A warns of his need to leave; B limits confidences to deep subjects.

boucles.cycle: A flees gatherings, cancels at the last moment (Hermit) → B insists, calls, "come, we're waiting" → A feels trapped, his system rises → B feels rejected, hurt → B's Abandoned Child → he gets angry, A gives in out of guilt then resents it → loop.
boucles.sortie: A offers a short defined presence; B accepts a partial formula without grudges.

triangle.danse: B invades and confides quickly (Persecutor), A endures and withdraws (Victim) — B's intrusion confirms to A that others are exhausting.

paires.profil_a: Intellectualizer / emotional cold (understands for not feeling, alexithymia)
paires.miroir_b: Volcanic / hyper-emotional (everything is felt, everything is said, everything overflows)
paires.blessure_commune: Invisible Child (“my emotions have no voice” – one exiles them, the other shouts them)
paires.activations: M: Intellectualizer (analysis instead of feeling) — P: Dissociative, Scroll — E: Invisible
paires.reveil: Feel without first understanding (A); think before you shout (B)
paires.piege: The “glacier × volcano” couple: one freezes, the other burns
micro_pas: Feel before understanding: name the body's emotion ("tight throat") before analyzing.
Count to 10 before shouting — then say the need underneath.

boucles.cycle: A analyzes not to feel (Intellectualizer), alexithymia → B is volcanic, says everything, overflows → A shuts down, rationalizes, dehumanizes B's pain → B shouts to be heard → A's Invisible Child: feeling = drowning → he flees into theory → B feels alone → loop.
boucles.sortie: A names ONE emotion with his body; B says hers in one sentence, without piling on.

boucles.cycle: B spills his feelings at the table, cries or shouts → A, uneasy, cognitive, "we need words", relativizes → B feels invalidated, rises → A's Cold part freezes everything → A's Guilty Child: if I feel, I do harm → he apologizes mechanically without feeling → loop.
boucles.sortie: A welcomes B's emotion without fixing it; B asks to be heard, not corrected.

triangle.danse: A freezes emotion into analysis (Persecutor), B overflows and collapses (Victim) — A's coldness fuels B's volcano, which justifies A's coldness.

paires.profil_a: Blamer/accuser (project all faults, “question yourself”—on others)—Woman
paires.miroir_b: Chronic guilty (apologizes for everything, bears all the blame)
paires.blessure_commune: Guilty Child (“If it’s my fault, I’m definitely bad” — one leaves it somewhere else, the other picks it up)
paires.activations: M: Accuser, Victim — P: Anger — E: Guilty
paires.reveil: Responsibility as power (A); innocence as a right (B)
paires.piege: The gears: one accuses, the other crashes — the fault goes around in circles without ever being posed
micro_pas: Replace "it's your fault" with "I felt… when…".
Practice NOT apologizing for a whole day.

boucles.cycle: A projects all faults (Accuser), "question yourself" → B, chronic guilty one, apologizes for everything and carries → A piles on, feels justified → B goes quiet, swallows, collapses internally → A's Guilty Child: if he doesn't denounce, he is the fault → he accuses more → loop.
boucles.sortie: A states his own share of the mistake before speaking of B's; B stops apologizing for what isn't his.

boucles.cycle: a reservation fails → A explodes, it's B's fault → B profusely apologizes, belittles himself → A feels legitimately angry → B, after a while, turns the accusation in an eruption (Angry part) → A's Humiliated Child → he collapses in turn → loop.
boucles.sortie: A names the setback without a culprit; B says "I don't accept being the fault".

triangle.danse: A accuses (Persecutor), B apologizes (Victim) — each accusation confirms to B that they are guilty, and to A that they are right.

paires.profil_a: Hypersexual / seducer (desire as proof of existence, conquests)
paires.miroir_b: Sexual blockage / confined desire (extinguished libido, fear of intimacy, non-sexual)
paires.blessure_commune: Humiliated + Invisible Child (same system: turning towards the other with your momentum = danger; one does it compulsively, the other no longer does it)
paires.activations: M: Seducer / Critic — P: Hypersexual / Fugitive — E: Invisible, Humiliated
paires.reveil: Intimacy without performance (A); the legitimate vital momentum (B) — cf. the principle “creative erection = sexual erection”
paires.piege: Consumption without encounter: one fills, the other empties
micro_pas: A gesture of intimacy without performance: a kiss, a resting hand, nothing more.
Say "I want you" — or "I don't feel like it" — without making it a proof.

boucles.cycle: A lives desire as proof of existence (Hypersexual Seducer) → B has low libido, fear of intimacy → A approaches, is overflowing → B shuts down, freezes → A feels rejected, his worth collapses (Humiliated Child) → he runs after other conquests to exist → B feels used → loop.
boucles.sortie: A separates desire from his worth; B names her fear of intimacy without rejecting A.

boucles.cycle: A is in distress, seeks the embrace to feel alive → B, sexually blocked, comforts with words but avoids the body → A lives this emptiness as rejection → he provokes, seduces, performs → A's Invisible Child: without reflected desire, he doesn't exist → B feels used → loop.
boucles.sortie: A asks explicitly "do I matter to you?"; B offers unambiguous contact.

triangle.danse: A pushes toward desire (Persecutor), B freezes and withdraws (Victim) — A's pressure numbs B, B's numbness starves A.

paires.profil_a: Liar / fabricator / embellished image
paires.miroir_b: Hyper-honest / brutally frank
paires.blessure_commune: Humiliated + Invisible Child (“if they knew the truth about me, they would reject me” – one embellishes it, the other throws it in my face)
paires.activations: M: Guardian of the image, Fabulator — P: Declarator — E: Humiliated
paires.reveil: Simple truth as safe ground (A); diplomacy as respect (B)
paires.piege: The war of truth: one feels betrayed, the other feels lied to
micro_pas: Say ONE uncomfortable truth, simply, without embellishing it.
Soften honesty without betraying it: "I'd rather tell you…".

boucles.cycle: A embellishes, arranges, lies for the image (Image Guard, Liar) → B, hyper-honest, says the raw truth → A is caught red-handed, feels humiliated → A's Cold/Accuser part rises, he counter-attacks → B insists, dismantles → A's Humiliated Child: being exposed = being destroyed → loop.
boucles.sortie: A tells the truth even ugly on one minor point; B announces the truth with a word of empathy.

boucles.cycle: A promises the impossible to please, biases → B, brutally frank, reveals the gap → A feels cornered, doubles down or flees → B, disgusted, closes up → A's Guilty Child → he digs himself in → B leaves mentally → loop.
boucles.sortie: A promises less but delivers; B tempers the frankness with "I want this to last".

triangle.danse: A embellishes to exist (Victim), B delivers raw truth (Persecutor) — B's frankness exposes A, who protects themselves by embellishing more.

paires.profil_a: Ascetic / “pure” / impulse control
paires.miroir_b: Unbridled/transgressor (sex, excess, body without shame)
paires.blessure_commune: Guilty Child (“pleasure is a fault” – one refuses it, the other commits it for both of them)
paires.activations: M: Moral criticism — P: Porno-punishment, Drunk — E: Guilty
paires.reveil: Innocent pleasure (A); the limit that protects (B)
paires.piege: Fascination-repulsion: one judges, the other enjoys — and shame circulates
micro_pas: Give yourself a small pleasure without having to earn it first.
Set a boundary coldly, without shame or provocation.

boucles.cycle: A lives his impulses as guilty, forbids himself (Ascetic) → B is uninhibited, lives the body without shame → A judges B, moralizes, withdraws → B feels abnormal, rebels even more → A closes up, his Guilty Child screams internally → B mocks or challenges → loop.
boucles.sortie: A says "I feel a judgment in me, not on you"; B accepts A's pace without challenging him.

boucles.cycle: A controls his plate, pleasure is suspect (Controller Ascetic) → B savors, spends, overflows → A watches and criticizes → B feels watched, not free → he overdoes it to free himself → A's Terrified Child: losing control = danger → loop.
boucles.sortie: A allows one delimited pleasure; B contains the excess within an agreed frame.

triangle.danse: A deprives and judges (Persecutor), B overflows shamelessly (Victim) — B's drive is the temptation A fights, A's control is the prison B flees.

paires.profil_a: Workaholic/survivor (working to exist, unable to do nothing)
paires.miroir_b: Idle / loitering (“I live my life”, I produce nothing and I am fine)
paires.blessure_commune: Abandoned + Invisible Child (“I am only worth what I produce”)
paires.activations: M: Perfectionist, Good Student — P: Workaholie (work IS the firefighter) — E: Abandoned
paires.reveil: Value without production (A); meaning and contribution (B)
paires.piege: Mutual judgment: “lazy” × “slave”
micro_pas: 10 minutes of voluntary emptiness a day, without screens or producing.
Offer someone a small concrete contribution, without expecting anything back.

boucles.cycle: A works to exist (Workaholic), can't do nothing → B is idle, loafs without guilt → A admires then judges, "you waste your time" → B feels useless in his eyes, flakes → A takes back the load, exhausts himself → his Angry/Dorsal part activates, he cracks → A's Invisible Child: without producing, he is nothing → loop.
boucles.sortie: A plans one real hour of rest and observes it; B values his rest out loud.

boucles.cycle: A carries everything, fills everything, exhausts himself (Survivor) → B produces nothing, "I live my life" → A feeds a silent resentment → his Critic suddenly explodes, accuses B of freeloading → B feels attacked, escapes → A's Abandoned Child: if I stop, do they still want me? → loop.
boucles.sortie: A asks for concrete help before the explosion; B offers a real task unasked.

triangle.danse: A produces endlessly and judges the other (Persecutor), B idles and feels judged (Victim) — A's agitation is the shadow of rest, B's rest is the shadow of action.

paires.profil_a: Arrogant/superior (contempt, never apologizes)
paires.miroir_b: Self-deprecating/humble-crushed (belittles oneself, refuses compliments)
paires.blessure_commune: Humiliated Child (one rises so as not to be down, the other lies down so as not to be hit)
paires.activations: M: Arrogant, Critical — P: Contempt, Self-humiliation — E: Humiliated
paires.reveil: The force that inclines (A); dignity that defends itself (B)
paires.piege: Two solitudes: the glass tower and the cellar
micro_pas: Say "I was wrong" without adding an excuse or justification.
Receive a compliment with a simple "thank you".

boucles.cycle: A believes himself superior, scorns (Arrogant) → B belittles himself, refuses compliments, lies down → A mistakes this submission for his worth → B, after a while, explodes or cries → A's Humiliated Child cracks (he can't be loved if he doesn't dominate) → A closes up harder → loop.
boucles.sortie: B stands firm on a disagreement; A hears an inferiority without feeling annihilated.

boucles.cycle: A flaunts his success, awaits admiration (Arrogant / Image Guard) → B compares, devalues himself in silence → A doesn't see the wound → B blunts, isolates → B's Invisible Child → A feels alone without a mirror → he lays it on thicker → loop.
boucles.sortie: A asks "what would do you good?"; B dares to say he is hurt.

triangle.danse: A rises above (Persecutor), B puts themselves down (Victim) — A's superiority needs B's self-crushing to hold.

paires.profil_a: Clown/jester (make people laugh to be kept, never be serious)
paires.miroir_b: Serious / rigid moral (never lightness, everything is serious)
paires.blessure_commune: Invisible Child (“I only exist through attention” – one through laughter, the other through virtue)
paires.activations: M: Clown, Good Student — P: Self-humiliation, Dorsal — E: Invisible
paires.reveil: Being seen serious (A); the lightness that liberates (B)
paires.piege: The “funny × killjoy” couple: one never takes themselves seriously, the other never laughs
micro_pas: Be serious once: say something true without making it a joke.
Allow yourself some lightness, without turning it into a lesson.

boucles.cycle: A makes people laugh to be kept (Clown), never serious → B is grave, everything is serious → A feels B is bored of him → he forces, overdoes the clown → B closes up, moralizes → A's Abandoned Child: without laughter, no one keeps him → A collapses or flees → loop.
boucles.sortie: A dares a serious moment without humor; B thanks A for his sensitivity, not for his act.

boucles.cycle: a grave situation arises → A jokes to defuse his discomfort (Clown) → B takes it badly, "that's not a joke topic" → A feels rejected → his Angry or Runaway part rises → B closes up, sad → A's Invisible Child: he can't be taken seriously → loop.
boucles.sortie: A says "I joke because I'm overwhelmed, help me"; B welcomes A's helplessness.

triangle.danse: A makes people laugh to be kept (Victim), B judges lightness (Persecutor) — B's seriousness confirms to A that they must entertain to exist.

paires.profil_a: Hoarder/miser (money as absolute security, anxiety about spending)
paires.miroir_b: Spendthrift/prodigal (money evaporates, immediate pleasure, debts)
paires.blessure_commune: Abandoned + Terrified Child (“money doesn’t leave; people do”)
paires.activations: M: Hoarder, Controller — P: Greed, Dorsal — E: Abandoned
paires.reveil: Security through links (A); foresight that protects (B)
paires.piege: The war of money which replaces the war of feelings
micro_pas: Spend a small amount on a pleasure, without feeling guilty.
Write down a purchase before making it — then wait an hour.

boucles.cycle: A is anxious about spending (Hoarder), watches → B spends, savors, "life is short" → A tenses, reproaches → B feels bridled, spends even more → A's Controller panics (Terrified Child: lack = danger) → loop.
boucles.sortie: A sets a non-negotiable pleasure budget; B keeps the agreed frame without exceeding it.

boucles.cycle: A postpones, hesitates, tightens savings → B wants, buys impulsively → A corrects, withdraws → B feels infantilized, rebels → A's Terrified Child → he retakes control over money → B lives money as joy, A as security → conflict → loop.
boucles.sortie: A announces "we have X for this"; B waits for a joint decision on that amount.

triangle.danse: A clenches and controls (Persecutor), B spends and disturbs (Victim) — B's spending threatens A's security, A's restriction suffocates B.

paires.profil_a: Jealous/possessive/monitoring
paires.miroir_b: Free/carefree (“I live my life, I owe nothing”)
paires.blessure_commune: Abandoned Child (“if I don’t watch over them, they leave me”)
paires.activations: M: Controller, Comparator — P: Angry — E: Abandoned
paires.reveil: Internal security (A); the commitment that reassures (B)
paires.piege: The prophecy fulfilled: one suffocates, the other leaves
micro_pas: Say the need instead of watching: "when you're away, I'm afraid of losing you".
Reassure once a day, spontaneously, without being asked.

boucles.cycle: A watches, jealous, possessive (Jealous Controller) → B lives his life, doesn't report → A interrogates, snoops, demands proof → B feels oppressed, drifts further away → A's Abandoned Child: the freer B is, the more A fears losing him → loop.
boucles.sortie: A states the fear ("I'm afraid of losing you") instead of watching; B reassures spontaneously with a gesture.

boucles.cycle: B has friends without A, leaves without him (Free) → A suffers, sets rules → B feels imprisoned, hides outings → A discovers them, rages, accuser → A's Abandoned Child → B sees the projection and gets scared → loop.
boucles.sortie: A asks for a shared moment to feel secure; B announces his outings without hiding them.

triangle.danse: A watches and accuses (Persecutor), B feels caged and escapes (Victim) — B's freedom fuels A's jealousy, A's jealousy justifies B's flight.

paires.profil_a: Emotional/fusional dependent (lives only in the couple, separation anxiety)
paires.miroir_b: Hyper-independent (“I don’t need anyone”, distance)
paires.blessure_commune: Abandoned Child (one clings, the other does not cling — same fear, two responses)
paires.activations: M: Giver, Anxious — P: Declarer, Supplication — E: Abandoned
paires.reveil: Autonomy in the link (A); the avowed need (B)
paires.piege: The “clamp × fleeing” couple — each confirming the fear of the other
micro_pas: Spend an evening without the other, deliberately, without filling the void.
Say "I need you" about one specific thing.

boucles.cycle: A only lives in the couple (codependent), separation anxiety → B is hyper-independent, "I need no one" → A calls, checks, clings → B feels smothered, takes distance → A's Abandoned Child panics, he clings more → B flees more → loop.
boucles.sortie: A cultivates an activity outside the couple; B initiates closeness before being asked.

boucles.cycle: After a fight, A fears it's the end, rushes to re-fuse → B needs solitude to repair → A lives this need as abandonment → he begs, demands closeness → B closes up → A's Humiliated Child: depending = being rejected → loop.
boucles.sortie: A tolerates 24h of distance; B comes back and shows it explicitly.

triangle.danse: A clings and begs (Victim), B distances and freezes (Persecutor) — A's need drives B away, B's flight panics A.

paires.profil_a: Caregiver/therapist/distress savior
paires.miroir_b: Chronic illness / in permanent crisis
paires.blessure_commune: Parentified Child (“I must save, I have no right to be weak”)
paires.activations: M: Savior, Repairer — P: Exhaustion, Dorsal — E: Parentified
paires.reveil: Receive care (A); regain your power (B)
paires.piege: Caregiver exhaustion and chronic helplessness of the care recipient — one role for two
micro_pas: Receive care without giving back: let someone do something for me.
Take back ONE small concrete responsibility, today.

boucles.cycle: A heals, rescues, helps (Healing Rescuer) → B is in permanent crisis, lets himself be carried → A empties himself, stops listening to himself → his Dorsal/Glutton parts activate at night → B asks for more → A's Parentified Child: if he doesn't save, he has no right to be a child → loop.
boucles.sortie: A ticks the hour when he stops saving; B learns to ask several sources, not only A.

boucles.cycle: B repeats the same complaint (illness, fatigue) → A listens, offers solutions → B "yes but" → A exhausts himself, his Critic whispers "always the same" → A's Angry part explodes → B feels abandoned, lays it on → A's Guilty Child → loop.
boucles.sortie: A says "I can't save you, but I'm here"; B names precisely what he expects (listen, not fix).

triangle.danse: A saves and heals (Rescuer), B is in permanent crisis (Victim) — B's distress gives A a role, A's care maintains B's distress.

paires.profil_a: Planner/organized/ritual
paires.miroir_b: Improviser / spontaneous (nothing is planned, everything is possible)
paires.blessure_commune: Terrified Child (one secures by the predictable, the other by avoiding any commitment)
paires.activations: M: Controller, Planner — P: Anesthetist — E: Terrified
paires.reveil: The unexpected as adventure (A); the frame as freedom (B)
paires.piege: The agenda against chaos — no one agrees
micro_pas: Say "we'll see" and actually live it: an outing with no plan.
Give advance notice about one important thing.

boucles.cycle: A plans, ritualizes everything (Planner) → B improvises, anything is possible → A corrects the itinerary, gets angry → B changes again → A's Controller tenses (Terrified Child: without plan, danger) → loop.
boucles.sortie: A keeps one free slot in the plan; B warns before undoing everything.

boucles.cycle: A wants the meal at a fixed time, a ritual → B eats when he wants, snacks → A feels ignored, his frame wavers → he imposes, judgment rises → B lives it as control → A's Terrified Child → loop.
boucles.sortie: A includes B in the schedules as a shared choice; B respects one fixed ritual chosen together.

triangle.danse: A organizes everything (Persecutor), B improvises and disturbs (Victim) — B's unpredictability ruins A's plans, A's plans suffocate B.

paires.profil_a: Sedentary/bodily off (body ignored, low energy)
paires.miroir_b: Sensory / adrenaline / sporty (living body, strong sensations) — Woman
paires.blessure_commune: Invisible + Humiliated Child (“my body is not a safe place”)
paires.activations: M: Hermit, Intellectualizer — P: Dorsal — E: Invisible
paires.reveil: Reinhabit the body (A); anchoring and rest (B)
paires.piege: Apathy versus restlessness: two ways not to meet
micro_pas: 2 minutes of body awareness: feet on the ground, breath, shoulders.
A moment of rest without stimulation — just being.

boucles.cycle: A is sedentary, body off, low energy (Dorsal) → B is sensory, adrenaline, athletic → B trains, presses → A feels useless, can't → A's Blocker/Hermit flees → B gets discouraged, lightly mocks → A's Humiliated Child → loop.
boucles.sortie: A picks a light low-intensity activity; B celebrates consistency, not performance.

boucles.cycle: A ignores his body, low energy → B, tactile and sensory, wants intense activities → A feels at fault, lies down → B is frustrated, spends his energy alone → A's Invisible Child: his body doesn't count → B feels alone in his living body → loop.
boucles.sortie: A wakes his body with a daily micro-gesture; B tames his intensity not to demand it.

triangle.danse: B lives through the body and adrenaline (Persecutor), A feels overwhelmed and switches off (Victim) — B's energy sends A back to their ignored body.

paires.profil_a: Resentful/tenacious (doesn't forgive, keeps list)
paires.miroir_b: Forgiving / “I’m moving on” (quickly let go, forget)
paires.blessure_commune: Abandoned + Humiliated Child (“forgive = be left/hurt again”)
paires.activations: M: Vigilante, Accuser — P: Angry — E: Abandoned
paires.reveil: Justice without hatred (A); memory without the poison (B)
paires.piege: The “prosecutor × amnesiac” couple: the list of grievances against the absence of accounts
micro_pas: Write the grudge on paper, then keep it for 24 hours before any decision.
Remember an old wound without replaying it.

boucles.cycle: A keeps the list, doesn't forgive (Grudge-holder) → B lets go, forgets, "moving on" → A brings the matter back → B thinks everything is settled, is destabilized → A feels entitled, the Accuser rises → B thinks A wants conflict → A's Guilty (or Abandoned) Child → loop.
boucles.sortie: A says what isn't settled when it starts; B commits to a precise repair, not an erasure.

boucles.cycle: At a celebration, an old wound resurfaces → A closes up, ruminates, punishes silently (Grudge-holder) → B sees nothing, enjoys → A lives it as indifference → he isolates, internal brooding → B, free, doesn't understand → A's Abandoned Child (no one repairs) → loop.
boucles.sortie: A names his wound that same evening; B listens without denying A's history.

triangle.danse: A keeps the list of wrongs (Persecutor), B lets go and endures the grudge (Victim) — B's forgiveness makes A's grudge unjustifiable, which strengthens it.

paires.profil_a: Cold / distant / “I don’t need affection”
paires.miroir_b: Tactile/demonstrative (hugs, sweet words, need for contact)
paires.blessure_commune: Invisible Child ("I lacked affection - one exiled it, the other begged for it")
paires.activations: M: Hermit, Intellectualizer — P: Dissociative — E: Invisible
paires.reveil: The contact that does not kill (A); the distance that doesn't give up (B)
paires.piege: One feels suffocated, the other feels frozen
micro_pas: A chosen, named touch: "I need a hug" or "not now".
Announced distance with a return date: "I'll be back in 1 hour".

boucles.cycle: A is cold, distant, "I don't need affection" (Cold/Hermit) → B is tactile, cuddly, demonstrative → B cuddles, A tenses, withdraws → B feels rejected, does more → A flees more → A's Terrified Child: contact = exposure → loop.
boucles.sortie: A defines a contact he tolerates and asks for it; B states the need for a hug instead of taking it.

boucles.cycle: B is upset, needs to be held → A freezes, offers solutions or silence → B feels alone in his pain → A, uneasy, busies himself elsewhere → B's Abandoned Child → B pushes A away coldly → A feels guilty → loop.
boucles.sortie: A consents to an agreed contact during distress; B says "I just want you to stay".

triangle.danse: A withholds affection (Persecutor), B begs for signs of love (Victim) — B's demand tightens A, A's withdrawal panics B.

paires.profil_a: Reactive/impulsive (acts first, thinks later, regrets)
paires.miroir_b: Thoughtful/slow (think first, act later, miss the moment)
paires.blessure_commune: Terrified Child (one flees the void through action, the other flees action through thought)
paires.activations: M: Survivor, Accuser — P: Angry, Reporter — E: Terrified
paires.reveil: The pause that saves (A); the moose that lives (B)
paires.piege: The “fire × ice” couple: one burns the stage before the other arrives
micro_pas: Before acting: 3 breaths, then "what do I really want?".
Seize an opportunity within the minute, without weighing everything.

boucles.cycle: A acts first, thinks after, regrets (Reactive) → B thinks first, acts after, sometimes misses the moment → A rushes, B hesitates → A's Persecutor blames him for doing wrong, B for not living → A's Humiliated Child revolts or collapses → loop.
boucles.sortie: A imposes a 5-minute pause before deciding; B gives himself a deadline to reply.

boucles.cycle: tension rises → A shouts, throws, acts impulsively (Reactive) → B keeps quiet, steps back, analyzes → A reads the silence as contempt, lays it on → B "misses the moment" and lets it burn → A's Terrified Child → loop.
boucles.sortie: A says "I'm too hot, I'll be back in 10 minutes"; B comes back to talk after the pause without blame.

triangle.danse: A overflows and cuts others off (Persecutor), B stays silent and misses the moment (Victim) — A's impulsiveness prevents B's slowness, B's slowness irritates A.

paires.profil_a: Red (consciousness) — power, fight, immediacy — Woman
paires.miroir_b: Emerging Blue/Orange — order, analysis, project
paires.blessure_commune: The same level of survival (two systems that have never known security)
paires.activations: M: Accuser, Survivor — P: Angry — E: All
paires.reveil: Power at the service of the link (A); analysis in the service of action (B)
paires.piege: The dialogue of the deaf: “you shout” / “you say nothing”
micro_pas: Turn an emotion into a request: "I feel…, I need…".
Decide in 5 minutes instead of analyzing for 5 days.

boucles.cycle: A is Red: strength, combat, immediacy (Accuser/Survivor, reactivity) → B is Blue/Orange: order, analysis, project → A wants direct power, B wants the frame → each sees the other as a threat → A's Terrified Child (losing the fight) and B's Humiliated Child (being outdone) → loop.
boucles.sortie: A converts a craving for power into a clear request; B gives A a position of quick impact.

boucles.cycle: A decides fast, wants to win (Red) → B analyzes, plans long (Blue/Orange) → A sees B's slowness as weakness, B sees A's haste as danger → the conflict explodes → each projects their shadow on the other → loop.
boucles.sortie: A proposes a quick winnable step; B shows that the frame protects A, not that it bridles him.

triangle.danse: Two forces colliding: A strikes hard and immediately, B structures and controls — each experiences the other as a threat, neither yields: two Persecutors.

paires.profil_a: Assumed victim (everything happens to me, “yes but”, refusal of solutions)
paires.miroir_b: Assumed executioner (dominates, humiliates, does not feel)
paires.blessure_commune: Humiliated + Terrified Child (the original scene of helplessness, replayed from both sides)
paires.activations: M: Victim — P: Complaint, Somatization — E: Humiliated
paires.reveil: Power over one's life (A); vulnerability (B)
paires.piege: ⚠️ Maximum trap: if the activation is unidirectional and B never questions himself, it is NOT a mirror — it is a system of violence. Awakening is only possible with a third party and separation. Never read this line as justification to stay
micro_pas: Replace "yes but" with "what can I do, right now?".
Acknowledge the other without dominating: "you were right on that point".

boucles.cycle: A presents himself as a victim of everything, "yes but", refusing solutions → B takes an abuser role, dominates, humiliates → A plays the complaint to be seen, B the domination to feel powerful → each triggers the other's shadow → the Humiliated Child in both → escalation or dependence → loop.
boucles.sortie: A steps out of the victim role by naming a power; B steps out of the abuser role by defusing domination.

boucles.cycle: A repeats that he suffers, piles up proofs of injustice → B, exasperated, "enough, own it" → A feels misunderstood, hijacked, plays the victim more → B hardens, dominates → A's Guilty and Humiliated Children reinforce each other → loop.
boucles.sortie: A owns a minimal share of responsibility; B replaces contempt with a firm and fair frame.

triangle.danse: A endures and claims powerlessness (Victim), B dominates and humiliates (Persecutor) — each humiliation confirms to A they are a victim, each complaint confirms to B they face a victim.

paires.profil_a: Wise / slow / meditative
paires.miroir_b: Restless / hyperactive / in a hurry
paires.blessure_commune: Terrified + Invisible Child (“if I stop, I collapse / if I don’t move, I don’t exist”)
paires.activations: M: Avoidant, Dorsal — P: Sleep, Dissociation — E: Terrified
paires.reveil: The action that anchors (A); the silence that nourishes (B)
paires.piege: The ivory tower against the whirlwind
micro_pas: 3 minutes of deliberate stillness, without purpose, without screens.
One quick, concrete action, without postponing it.

boucles.cycle: A is slow, ascetic, statically meditative (Sage) → B is restless, rushed, hyperactive → B presses, A stops → B lives A's rhythm as loss, A lives B's as hysteria → A's Terrified Child (agitation = danger) and B's Anxious Child (stopping = death) → loop.
boucles.sortie: A sets a shared pause time; B sees in A not slowness but depth.

boucles.cycle: A savors the process, unhurried → B wants results right away, stirs → A finds him noisy, B finds A soft → B's Controller races, A withdraws → A's Invisible Child (his depth isn't seen) → loop.
boucles.sortie: A shows what slowness produces; B allocates a calm time without filling it.

triangle.danse: B rushes and bustles (Persecutor), A gets overwhelmed and withdraws (Victim) — B's agitation is unbearable to A's silence, A's silence feels empty to B.

styles_attachement.dynamique: The chase-flight dance: each withdrawal of one triggers the pursuit of the other, each chase triggers the withdrawal
Exact mirror of the line above (both lines are the same pair)
Healing mirror: one learns security through contact with a system that neither leaves nor invades — but be careful: the Secure exhausts if the Disorganized does not engage

styles_attachement.miroir: (no longer has a mirror of injury — attracts mirrors of growth: a person who carries a quality that he aspires to develop, without traumatic activation)
styles_attachement.dynamique: No awakening through crisis — awakening through expansion

stades_eveil.description: The shock of familiarity: “I’ve known you forever.” Neuroception recognizes the same frequency of injury.
stades_eveil.piege: Confusing recognition and destiny, and jumping into the merger.

stades_eveil.description: The entire system rises: Managers defending, Firefighters driving, Exiles screaming. Each behavior of the other is a key.
stades_eveil.piege: Fleeing (“we are incompatible”) or clinging (“I’m going to fix him/her”) — both are escapes: the mirror is to be read, not to be escaped or repaired.

stades_eveil.description: The breaking point — AND something that doesn't fit with the story. This is the gap through which awakening can pass, provided that a third party (or an accessible Self) names the system.
stades_eveil.piege: Close the dissonance by locking the story (total idealization or total devaluation).

stades_eveil.description: Everyone reintegrates their disavowed part — or the same mirror returns under a new face. If the same pattern is repeated with different faces, the lesson is not learned.
stades_eveil.piege: Waiting for the other to change instead of reinstating your own part.

discrimination_miroir_leurre.vrai: Bilateral: he triggers me AND I trigger him

discrimination_miroir_leurre.leurre: I am alone in feeling the intensity

discrimination_miroir_leurre.vrai: Each conflict reveals ONE specific, nameable part
discrimination_miroir_leurre.leurre: Blurred conflicts, without teaching, always the same

discrimination_miroir_leurre.vrai: Dissonance exists (“it’s not what I thought”)
Both end up showing their hurt
discrimination_miroir_leurre.leurre: Only one is revealed; the other remains in a position of power

discrimination_miroir_leurre.vrai: Possible integration (with or without the relationship)

questions_miroir.titre: What irritates me the most in other people?
questions_miroir.cible: The disavowed part (negative projection) — “I can’t stand people who shout” = I had to swallow my voice.
The exiled part (positive projection) — “I admire people who dare” = I have exiled my audacity.

questions_miroir.titre: What do I always repeat, with different faces?
questions_miroir.cible: The common wound (resonance) — “everyone leaves eventually” = I choose people who leave.

questions_miroir.titre: What am I running away from/fearing most in the world?
questions_miroir.cible: The central Exile — “being seen as a monster” = the shame of the Humiliated Child.

questions_miroir.titre: If this quality or flaw I see in the other person were a PART OF ME hidden in the Shadow... how old would it be, and what would it need from my Self?
questions_miroir.cible: Reintegration (the “magic question” of IFS) — the projection becomes a doorway: name the part, give it an age, entrust it to the Self (U-Turn then reparenting).

decodage_projections.reaction: “I judge them, I despise them, they disgust me.”
decodage_projections.ombre: The repressed Exile + permission to live the forbidden need (letting go, saying no, resting).
decodage_projections.cle: The intensity: a simple observation comes from the Self; a visceral, charged reaction is a projection.

decodage_projections.reaction: “I hate them, they are dangerous, monstrous, I must flee or destroy.”
decodage_projections.ombre: The terror of a past trauma + the system's own defensive rage, demonized.
decodage_projections.cle: The disproportion: the Firefighter fights outside the terror that lives inside, believing in an external evil.

decodage_projections.reaction: “They are fascinating, perfect, they will save or complete me.”
decodage_projections.ombre: “The Golden Shadow”: their own worth, creative power and beauty delegated to the other.
decodage_projections.cle: Flawless idealization: the qualities seen in the other mirror what is locked away in oneself.

regle_miroir: A mirror reflects in both directions. If the other never reflects anything, it is not a mirror: it is a wall.

loi_parentale.texte: "As long as we keep resenting a parent — even unconsciously — our relationships with all other people of the same sex as that parent will be difficult." The mirror plays out first there: with the figures who resemble the parent.
cles: People of the same sex as the parent trigger more strongly, for no apparent reason
The parent we got along with best as a teenager is often the one we have the most to resolve with
What wasn't resolved with a parent carries on with people of the same sex as them

triangle_vie.texte: Every wound activates in three ways, to the same degree: I'm affected by another person's attitude; I feel guilty toward someone; I suffer from what I do to myself. If only one of the three is conscious, the other two still exist.
triangle_vie.exemple: Example: if being lied to bothers you a lot, you feel guilty about lying to the same degree — and you lie to yourself. The triangle becomes a detector: as soon as you become aware of one "I am", you know the other two faces exist.
